Outliers: daily changes flagged by a Hampel filter
History: 2005-10-03 to 2019-10-01 (train and validation; the test days are never examined here). A change is flagged when it lies more than 3 robust standard deviations (1.4826 x the median absolute deviation) from the median of the changes within 10 days on either side. The median and spread are taken after removing the window's profile by season position (every 5 days), so a regular rhythm is not flagged. Each model's tuned 'outliers' setting decides whether flagged changes are left as they are, clipped to the bounds, or given a pulse regressor; forecasts are always scored against the actual data.
